Reviewer #1 (Remarks to the Author):

The authors follow growth on a synthetic carbon source. The data are of interest.

The first concern is the missing temperature unit in the Methods.

The second concern is the claim of novelty, which needs a citation.

Reviewer #2 (Remarks to the Author):

Specific comments:
(1) Add error bars to Fig. 2.
(2) State how growth was followed.
(3) Name the antifoam agent.

Reviewer #3 (Remarks to the Author):

I have no further requests. The revision can be accepted once the units are added.
